# ExperimentalInterface schemas
{: .no_toc}

Type-specific details of experimental interfaces: the point where hardware meets the animal or tissue, such as an implanted probe, a cranial window or an optic fiber.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`experimentalinterface`](/api/modules/experimentalinterface/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- [`experimentalinterfacetemplate`](/api/modules/experimentalinterfacetemplate/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ExperimentalInterface/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ExperimentalInterface/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ExperimentalInterface/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

### ECG

- type code `ECG` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ExperimentalInterface/ECG/1.0.2.json)

Electrodes recording cardiac electrical activity.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `leadConfiguration` | Lead configuration | text |  |  | The arrangement and roles of the installed ECG leads. |
| `electrodeLayout` | Electrode layout | text (multi-line) |  |  | The spatial arrangement of electrodes in the installed interface. |

### ECoG

- type code `ECoG` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ExperimentalInterface/ECoG/1.0.0.json)

A grid or strip array of contacts installed on the dura, on the brain surface, or on thinned skull. Created by an ECoG implant procedure; the array's design (contact count, pitch, substrate) lives on the ECoG array material row and its catalog entry.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `deviceIdentifier` | Device identifier | text |  |  | The device's own identifier: the manufacturer's serial number, or the code the lab marks on the hardware and writes on the cage card and the surgery sheet. This is not the name given to this record. |
| `placementLayer` | Placement layer | choice |  | one of `epidural`, `subdural`, `epicranial` | Which tissue layer the installed array rests on: the dura, the brain surface under an opened dura, or the bone. |
| `referenceConfiguration` | Reference configuration | text |  |  | How the array's reference input is wired as installed: a skull screw, an on-array contact or a recording contact. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "deviceIdentifier": "text",
    "placementLayer": "epidural"
}
```

### Multi-electrode array (MEA)

- type code `MultiElectrodeArray` · version 2.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ExperimentalInterface/MultiElectrodeArray/2.0.1.json)

A planar or grid array of electrodes, common for ex-vivo and surface recording.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `deviceIdentifier` | Device identifier | text |  |  | The device's own identifier: the manufacturer's serial number, or the code the lab marks on the hardware and writes on the cage card and the surgery sheet. This is not the name given to this record. |
| `electrodeCount` | Electrode count | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of electrodes present on the configured array. |
| `electrodePitchUm` | Electrode pitch (µm) | number |  | ≥ 0 | Centre-to-centre distance between adjacent electrodes. |
| `electrodeDiameterUm` | Electrode diameter (µm) | number |  | ≥ 0 | The electrode diameter in micrometres. |
| `substrateType` | Substrate type | text |  |  | The material or construction type of the electrode-array substrate. |
| `referenceConfiguration` | Reference configuration | text |  |  | The reference-channel or reference-electrode arrangement used by the interface. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "deviceIdentifier": "text",
    "electrodeCount": 1
}
```
